dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular and serrated outer perimeters of three prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the dorsal-lateral midsection; perimeter edges exhibit a high-contrast gradient transition from charcoal-grey to pale-cream, with the largest central annulus showing a fragmented, non-continuous border.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid-white pixel clusters concentrated primarily along the dorsal ridge and mid-flank; core pixel concentrations are highest in the anterior-midsection where clusters form dense, asymmetrical groupings.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A scalene triangular relationship is formed by connecting the centroids of the three most prominent 'O' shaped macro-annuli situated on the upper-mid ridge, the central flank, and the posterior lateral region; a secondary linear alignment of four small high-intensity blobs runs parallel to the dorsal curvature.
